steps.path: Assistant settings → General; session menu; Resume Session
steps.headline: This is what done means for session naming.

rows.statement: Basic is selected when no naming preference is saved, without changing existing session names.
AI reviews names after replies 1 and 3, then every 25 completed replies, without an interval setting; tool steps do not count.
Assistant settings offers Off, Basic, and AI: Off keeps names without automatic naming; Basic keeps a short first-message name without AI calls.

rows.statement: AI naming uses the conversation model or a separately chosen model, explains reviews and provider usage under information, and keeps names that still fit.
rows.note: we can clean this up/simplify a bit. too much text

rows.statement: An active session’s menu offers Rename session above Move to new window.
Save name protects a chosen name from automatic changes in every mode, even when unchanged; blank names cannot be saved.
The naming model has shorter copy without repeated reassurance, with details under the information button.
rows.note: this still doesn't match the card/container styling used for all other options on the page.

rows.statement: Saved sessions can be renamed without reopening the conversation, using the same dialog as active sessions.
rows.note: no. the name in the resume card should have a pencil icon directly to the right of it. no "rename" button.

rows.statement: At phone width, the saved-session rename dialog’s name field, Cancel, and Save name fit without horizontal scrolling.
Session naming matches surrounding General cards’ background, rounded corners, padding, and title styling, keeping naming choices and the model picker together.
The rename dialog offers only Cancel and Save name, with no automatic-name reset or replacement action.
Saved names keep the file viewer’s exact pencil and dotted underline always visible, with the pencil directly beside the name; clicking anywhere renames.
